title: test: make Enter suite self-contained
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Builds SDK, UI, and Enter frontend artifacts automatically before the standard test command.
- Keeps hermetic tests on the tracked test environment instead of requiring decrypted development secrets.
- Runs the complete Enter suite in pull-request CI and reuses the generated artifacts for typechecking.
- Updates stale API-key fixtures to create keys through the production account route.

Tests:
- npm test: 829 passed
- Enter TypeScript check
- Focused API-key tests: 27 passed

gist.headline: The test hive seals itself
gist.blurb: Enter’s test garden now brings its own tools, artifacts, and keys. Fewer secret handoffs, more reproducible buzzing.
gist.summary: Made the Enter test suite self-contained by building SDK, UI, and frontend artifacts before tests, using the tracked test environment, running the full suite in PR CI, and creating API-key fixtures through the production account route.
gist.impact: Contributors get more reliable pull-request validation for Enter, with 829 tests and focused API-key coverage running without decrypted development secrets.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is a careful test gardener tending a sealed greenhouse full of tiny code-plants, while the eager CRT monitor robot checks a completed test checklist. Small key-shaped seedlings and neatly packed build artifacts represent hermetic fixtures and reused CI outputs.
